Turn ideas into shipped software.

HagiCode is an agentic coding workspace. OpenSpec workflows plan the change, multi-agent execution carries it out, and Hero Scenario makes the long run visible, so ideas become shipped software.

Download HagiCodeProduct Docs
Smart
OpenSpec workflows turn intent into a path from proposal to shipped change.
Efficient
Multi-agent execution runs research, build, and review in parallel.
Fun
Rich UI interactions make planning, agent work, and projects easier to follow.
